header.title: How to Install a Refrigerator Lock
header.description: This guide provides instructions on how to secure your refrigerator with a lock, preventing unauthorized access. It covers cleaning the fridge, attaching lock hinges, and installing a lockset with a padlock.

steps.description: Clean the front and side of the fridge where the lock will be installed to ensure proper adhesion.
actions: Clean the front and side of the fridge where the lock will be.
Apply rubbing alcohol to a clean rag.
Scrub off any dirt or grime from the fridge’s surface.
Use a Clorox magic eraser for extreme grime (optional).

steps.description: Apply the fridge lock hinges to the fridge and door, ensuring a firm adhesive bond.
actions: Allow rubbing alcohol to completely dry.
Apply fridge lock hinges, preferably at the top of the fridge.
Place one hinge on the side of the fridge.
Place one hinge on the fridge door.
Apply as much pressure as possible to ensure the lock sets firmly.
Allow the hinge adhesive to settle for about an hour.
Give the new addition a few firm tugs to ensure it's firmly in place.

steps.description: This step involves selecting and applying a lockset to secure the refrigerator.
actions: Scramble the code after every entry (if using a code entry padlock)
Protect the key (if using a key-locked fridge)
